name: codex-pi-coordination
description: Coordinate bounded tasks, saved Pi conversations and model capability discovery inside NVIDIA OpenShell.

interface.shortDescription: Run scoped Pi tasks and continue saved work.
interface.longDescription: Codex owns scope, integration and acceptance. Pi executes fresh assignments in an owned OpenShell sandbox, optionally continuing a verified saved conversation. The runner retains bounded artifacts, actual checks and managed cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-pi-coordination to delegate a bounded task to Pi and verify the returned work.
